selective_compensation.mechanism: The common regional query supplies y. A removed postcontact DY can therefore be restored at the next encounter; this does not erase B's acquired z. The distinct DZ-removal control cannot get z from that query.
selective_compensation.boundary: A field read by a microscopic rule need not be necessary after prepared contextual compensation; no claim of universal repair.

source_of_scores: Actual finite F/R delivery records; external utility is not fed into the Runtime
not_independent_samples: Cases share apparatus and some are diagnostic complete-state forks; ticks and episodes are not treated as replicas
